stem:
Meena counts 15 rose plants growing together in her school garden in Jaipur on one Monday morning. Her teacher asks: is this group a population?
To decide, check both conditions:
• all the organisms counted are of the same kind
• they are counted in the same habitat at a given place and time
Which row shows the correct decision for Meena's count?
all organisms of the same kind / same habitat, place and time
tables: {"headers":["all organisms of the same kind","same habitat, place and time"],"rows":[["✓","✓"],["✓","✗"],["✗","✓"],["✗","✗"]],"row_labels":["A","B","C","D"],"caption":"","is_option_table":true}

teacher.key_rationale: The 15 rose plants are all one kind of organism, counted together in one habitat (the school garden) at a given place and time (Jaipur, one Monday morning), so both conditions hold and the group is a population: ✓/✓, option A. Option B is the trap for a student who drops the 'same place and time' condition and marks it ✗ even though it is stated in the stem.
